title: Clause 6 - Planning
description: Working paper template for ISO/IEC 42001 Clause 6: AI risk and impact assessments, objectives, planning of changes.

sections.title: AI risk assessment (6.1.2)
prompts: Verify the AI risk assessment process is documented and applied.
Confirm coverage of risks to individuals, groups, society, and the organization.
Cross-check identified risks against MIT AI Risk Repository / AVID / MITRE ATLAS for completeness.

sections.title: AI system impact assessment (6.1.4)
prompts: Confirm AI impact assessments exist for each in-scope AI system.
Verify impact considers fundamental rights, fairness, environmental factors.
Confirm sign-off authority and review cadence.

sections.title: AI objectives and planning (6.2)
prompts: Confirm AI objectives are measurable and time-bound.
Verify alignment with the AI policy and overall business strategy.

sections.title: Planning of changes (6.3)
prompts: Verify that material changes to AI systems trigger re-assessment.

checklists.text: Risk assessments performed for each AI system in scope.
AI impact assessments exist and are signed off.
AI objectives are SMART and tracked.
Risk treatment plans link to specific Annex A controls.

suggestedInterviewQuestions: How do you scope an AI risk assessment for a new system?
Walk us through an impact assessment for a high-impact use case.
How are AI objectives linked to operational metrics?
